translationPolicy.identity: generated Chinese remains a reading projection of the same canonical Work; never create a fake Chinese edition
translationPolicy.bibleExclusion: scripture quotations inside an eligible non-Bible work may remain contextual source material, but the Bible itself and Bible-translation resources are excluded from Dawn translation admission

classificationRule: One primary reader-facing family plus zero or more secondary facets. Patristic is a period/tradition facet, not a separate silo that hides these works from theology/spirituality/history browsing.
dedupRule: Before canonical promotion compare author/title/work identity against PRDL, CatholicCorpus, Corpus Corporum and existing Dawn Works; editions/translations become relations under one Work where appropriate.
visualRule: Resolve source edition/title-page/cover after identity reconciliation; do not invent historical covers during admission.
nextPass: Continue enumerating structured_text works in upstream order, classify them into Dawn reader-facing families, run cross-source identity reconciliation, and promote only records with preserved provenance/rights/readable text.
